text: Figure 6.5: ISignal example The example in Figure 6.5 shows the usage of ISignalGroups and ISignals. In this example a record is mapped to a SystemSignalGroup. All ApplicationRecordElements with ApplicationPrimitiveDataType are mapped to individual SystemSignals. If the same SystemSignalGroup is sent to different receivers (RTE Fanout) then two different ISignalGroups are created.
